name: University of Limerick
description: The University of Limerick is a public university on a riverside campus outside Limerick city, founded in 1972 as the National Institute for Higher Education, Limerick and granted university status in 1989. It is known for its cooperative education programme, which places most undergraduates in paid work placements.
whyIncluded: The University of Limerick is among the 10 universities in Ireland most chosen by international students (about 20% of its 14,897 full-time-equivalent students are international, THE World University Rankings 2027 data), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.
